consensus_summary: Fruit primarily symbolizes the visible outward product or evidence of inner spiritual condition—character, conduct, virtues, and works (esp. fruit of the Spirit)—by which the source is known and tested.
book_summary: The works produced by a person or people, revealing the tree and supplying the basis for judgment.
consensus_core_identification: outward produce/evidence of the inner source (character, works)
book_core_identification: works that reveal the tree/source and ground judgment
rationale: Minimum cores are identical: fruit = the produced works/evidence that disclose the nature of the person/tree and furnish the criterion of judgment. Consensus detail on virtues, Spirit, converts, etc., and the book’s brevity are wording or scope-of-presentation differences only, not a shift of referent or boundary.
strongest_objection: Book’s exclusive focus on ‘works’ and judgment might be read as excluding pure character traits or non-judgmental senses, yet those remain within the same core produce-of-the-tree category.
